actors.name: Logistics Service Provider (LSP)
actors.description: Core registered user. Umbrella term covering NVOCC, wholesale Freight Forwarder, Freight Forwarder, Transporter, Farmers, and Customer/Clearing agents. Each LSP sees only shipments allocated to them. Can delegate to another LSP or a one-off P4TC. Replaces the previous WFF/FF/Carrier actor split. Note: roles are contextual per HBL — the same organisation can appear at different levels (e.g. top-level party on one HBL, delegatee on another). Visibility and role enforcement must be HBL-scoped, not user-scoped.
actors.auth: Username + password. Created by ACFS admin in the portal.

responsibilities.description: View list of assigned HBLs with shipment status, milestone, payment, delegation, and booking info. Data auto-synced on login and on subsequent integration layer calls.
Select one or multiple shipments to take action on (delegate or book).

Delegate shipments to an existing LSP (search and select) or add a new one-off LSP, which creates a P4TC with email + secure link. Per HBL — if delegated, LSP cannot also book directly on that same HBL (BR-004).

Book pickup directly: system validates booking readiness (unpacked + customs cleared + DOs present) → upload missing docs → load calculation + pricing → select slot → enter truck and driver details (select existing or add new, scoped to account) → accept T&Cs + site induction → make payment (Stripe/Compay) → receive booking confirmation with reference number. Requires HBL milestone "unpacked" or later (BR-001).
Request missing docs when DOs are unavailable. Booking process is aborted (offline) until DO is received.
Upload Delivery Order for downstream enforcement.
Flag an HBL as under-bond. Manually set in portal — not synced from Maximus.

Modify booking before cutoff: change slot date/time and HBLs (add/remove) before booking cutoff. Change truck/driver at any time until shipment is collected. Cost-impacting changes after cutoff require ACFS (BR-015).

actors.name: Party to Collect (P4TC)
actors.description: Tertiary/one-off user with no portal credentials. Receives email with shipment roster and document portal URL. No persistent account or history. Replaces previous "One-off Customer" and "Freight Forwarder" (magic-link) actors.
actors.auth: Magic link + OTP. No login required — clicks link from email, verifies via OTP. Portal access scoped to assigned shipments only. Link expires on collection.

responsibilities.description: Access portal via emailed link (no login). Verify identity with OTP.
View list of assigned HBLs from the delegation.
Delegate shipments further: enter P4TC name + email ID, optionally upload new DO. System sends email with shipment roster and secure link to the new P4TC.

Book pickup: validate booking readiness → load calculation + pricing → select slot → enter truck and driver details (name, license#, phone — no saved drivers for P4TC) → accept T&Cs + site induction → make payment → receive booking confirmation with reference.
Upload missing DO or contact ACFS for support if DO is unavailable.

actors.name: Driver
actors.description: Secondary user. No portal access. No direct system communication — the booking party manages driver rostering externally and forwards booking details to the driver.
actors.auth: No portal auth. No system emails. Booking party forwards confirmation externally.

responsibilities.description: Receive booking reference from booking party (forwarded externally — system does NOT email the driver directly).
Present booking reference and identity at gatehouse for pickup verification.

actors.name: ACFS Internal
actors.description: Internal ACFS staff. Two sub-roles: Admin (full privileges) and User (predefined/restricted privileges). Manages HBL assignment, slot configuration, booking operations, DO validation, pickup verification, and user management.
actors.auth: SSO-based access. Admin and User sub-roles with predefined privileges.

responsibilities.description: HBL Assignment (remedial/optional): manually assign HBLs to LSPs when auto-assignment fails or data issues arise. System lists unassigned FAK shipments. Low priority for Phase 1 — data fix preferred over UI.
ECST Assignment: assign ECST to shipments (OQ-031 — flow undefined).

Slot Configuration: select site → select days of week → set start/end time per slot (flexible, overlapping allowed) → configure booking cutoff and change cutoff (relative day + time, e.g. "previous working day, 4 PM") → optionally set heat map threshold value (nice-to-have) → block holidays via calendar overlay → save/update slots.

Manage Booking: search bookings by booking ref# or by truck/driver details → view details (slot date/time, booking party, HBLs, fees paid, driver/truck) → update: change date/time, add/remove HBLs, change driver/truck. Admin can override cutoffs. Booking update notification sent via email to booking party.

DO Validation (separate from pickup verification): view list of bookings with unvalidated DOs → validate DO against lowest-level HBL details → mark as validated. HBL-centric, not booking-centric. Can be done by offshore team. Prioritise by slot date/time.

Pickup Verification: search bookings by ref# or truck/driver → view details + DO validation status + audit tracking → validate or reject. If validated, change booking status to "processed". If not validated, booking is flagged. Includes DO validation if not already done.
User Management: create, update, and remove users (LSP and ACFS internal). Configure feature permissions per user.
Override missing DO requirement. Restricted to Admin role. Audit trail with reason required. One-time per HBL, lives until collected.
FOC rebooking for no-shows. Admin only. Overrides all fees. Reason/justification required for audit trail.
Flag an HBL as under-bond.
Partially process bookings — clear HBLs proceed while blocked ones are rebooked separately.
Edit HBL details and update milestones/statuses manually when corrections are needed.
Edit delegation — reassign or revoke delegation between parties.

actors.name: Gatehouse
actors.description: ACFS gatehouse staff who verify and confirm physical vehicle entry/exit for pickups. Part of the Pickup Verification flow.

responsibilities.description: Verify booking reference, driver identity, and truck rego on arrival.
Confirm vehicle exit to mark booking as collected.

entities.name: House Bill of Lading (HBL)
entities.description: Primary tracking unit for a shipment. Sourced from Maximus via periodic batch (once or twice daily). Two orthogonal dimensions: milestone (physical progress) and HBL status (delegation/booking state). HBLs exist in a hierarchy: AGS issues master HBLs (often 500-prefix), freight forwarders issue lower-level HBLs (e.g. 4033-prefix for Mondial). Mostly 1:1 parent-child relationship. The portal primarily deals with the lowest-level HBL as the primary identifier.

key_fields.name: hbl_number
key_fields.description: Primary identifier — lowest-level house bill number from Maximus.

key_fields.name: alt_hbl_reference
key_fields.description: Alternative/parent HBL reference (e.g. AGS master HBL). Optional — present when hierarchy exists. Relationship established via AGS data feed, not Maximus.
key_fields.warn: Exact data source for HBL hierarchy relationship TBD — Matt and William resolving (OQ-034).

key_fields.name: container_number
key_fields.description: Container reference — ties HBL to the top-level container.

key_fields.name: ocean_bl
key_fields.description: Ocean bill of lading. Multiple containers may share one ocean BL.

key_fields.name: consignee
key_fields.description: Next party in the chain. Data source is AGS feed (not ICS/Maximus — too inconsistent). Identified by account name or account code.

key_fields.name: weight_kg
key_fields.description: Weight measurement for fee calculation.

key_fields.name: volume_m3
key_fields.description: Volumetric measurement for fee calculation.

key_fields.name: chargeable_weight
key_fields.description: Max of weight vs volume per HBL. Used for fee calculation: chargeable_weight × rate. Calculated and stored as a field.

key_fields.name: quantity
key_fields.description: Number of packages (e.g. 3 boxes). Optional — may not be required for decision-making.

key_fields.name: pack_type
key_fields.description: Package type description. Optional — may not be required for decision-making.

key_fields.name: description
key_fields.description: Goods description. Two source fields exist in Maximus: "description" and "marks and numbers" — may consolidate.

key_fields.name: milestone
key_fields.description: Physical progress milestone. Linear progression. Sourced from Maximus batch sync.
key_fields.warn: Milestone list is based on PM knowledge — pending client confirmation (OQ-021).

key_fields.name: hbl_status
key_fields.description: Delegation/booking status. Separate dimension from milestone. "assigned" means allocated to an LSP. "delegated" means LSP has passed to another party. "booked" means pickup is scheduled.

key_fields.name: customs_clearance_status
key_fields.description: Customs clearance state including quarantine. Must be fully cleared (not partial) for booking. Shown in HBL table. Sourced from Maximus — update frequency from ICS unclear.

key_fields.name: under_bond
key_fields.description: Flag — NOT a lifecycle state. Manually set by LSP/ACFS in portal. Skips DO requirement. Not synced from Maximus.
key_fields.warn: Full under-bond concept needs deeper clarification (OQ-025).

key_fields.name: under_bond_verified
key_fields.description: Whether ACFS has verified the under-bond marking. Verification happens outside the portal; portal records the result. Set by ACFS staff only.

key_fields.name: storage_fee_flag
key_fields.description: Visual indicator that storage fees apply. Derived from last_free_storage_date — auto-calculated, not manually set.

key_fields.name: last_free_storage_date
key_fields.description: Last date of free storage. After this date, storage_fee_flag is automatically set to true. Sourced from Maximus or set by ACFS.

key_fields.name: release_type
key_fields.description: Determines DO requirements. Free release removes DO requirement for that tier.
key_fields.warn: Full list of release types pending client confirmation (OQ-022).

key_fields.name: assigned_lsp
key_fields.description: LSP this HBL is allocated to. Set by ACFS during HBL/WFF assignment or auto-assigned from data.

transitions.trigger: Goods physically picked up from warehouse
transitions.guard: Booking in "processed" state + gatehouse confirms exit

lifecycle.warn: Milestones only — delegation and booking are tracked via hbl_status, a separate dimension. Delegation can happen at any milestone (BR-001). Booking requires milestone "unpacked" or later (BR-001).

entities.name: Booking
entities.description: Groups one or more HBLs into a pickup window with driver/truck details. Created by LSP or P4TC. No truck type distinction for Phase 1 — booking party is responsible for bringing the correct truck.

key_fields.name: booking_id
key_fields.description: System-generated unique reference number.

key_fields.name: pickup_window
key_fields.description: Selected date/time slot.

key_fields.name: hbl_ids
key_fields.description: HBLs included in this booking. Can span multiple LSPs.

key_fields.name: driver_name
key_fields.description: Driver performing pickup.

key_fields.name: driver_license
key_fields.description: Driver license number.

key_fields.name: truck_rego
key_fields.description: Vehicle registration.

key_fields.name: fee_amount
key_fields.description: Sum of (chargeable_weight × rate) per HBL + minimum charge. Calculated per HBL individually, then summed.
key_fields.warn: Minimum charge amount TBD. Rate is a single flat value for Phase 1 (OQ-023).

key_fields.name: booking_party
key_fields.description: LSP or P4TC who created the booking.

key_fields.name: tc_accepted
key_fields.description: Whether booking party accepted terms and conditions.

key_fields.name: site_induction_accepted
key_fields.description: Whether driver site induction was acknowledged. Skipped if driver already has site_induction = true.

transitions.trigger: LSP or P4TC confirms, accepts T&Cs + site induction, and pays
transitions.guard: All HBLs at milestone "unpacked" or later + fully customs cleared + release conditions met + missing docs uploaded + T&Cs accepted

transitions.trigger: ACFS validates DOs + audit tracking and marks ready. Partial processing allowed — clear HBLs proceed, blocked ones rebook separately.
LSP or ACFS cancels booking. Cancellation reason required (ACFS). Refund processed outside system.

entities.name: Pickup Slot
entities.description: A configurable time window at a specific site. Configured by ACFS admin. No truck type distinction for Phase 1.

key_fields.name: slot_id
key_fields.description: System-generated unique ID.

key_fields.name: site
key_fields.description: Physical site/location for pickup (references site entity).

key_fields.name: days_of_week
key_fields.description: Days this slot template applies to (e.g. Monday-Friday).

key_fields.name: start_time
key_fields.description: Slot start time.

key_fields.name: end_time
key_fields.description: Slot end time.

key_fields.name: booking_cutoff
key_fields.description: Booking cutoff — relative day (e.g. "previous_working_day", "same_day") + time (e.g. "16:00"). Bookings not accepted after this point.

key_fields.name: change_cutoff
key_fields.description: Change cutoff — same format as booking cutoff. Changes to slot/date/HBLs not allowed after this point (truck/driver changes exempt).

key_fields.name: heat_map_threshold
key_fields.description: Threshold value for density indicator. System auto-calculates green/orange/red zones. Nice-to-have for Phase 1.
key_fields.warn: Heat map indicator is nice-to-have — not required for MVP (OQ-036).

key_fields.name: is_blocked
key_fields.description: Whether slot is blocked due to holiday/blackout date.

entities.name: Site
entities.description: Physical warehouse/pickup location. Seeded directly in the database — no admin CRUD UI for Phase 1.

key_fields.name: site_name
key_fields.description: Human-readable site name (e.g. "Port Botany Warehouse").

key_fields.name: branch_code
key_fields.description: Branch code (e.g. "SY", "MB", "BR"). Multiple sites can share a branch code.

lifecycle.warn: Static entity — DB-seeded, no state transitions in Phase 1.

entities.name: Driver Record
entities.description: Saved driver details for reuse across bookings. Built up organically by booking parties — no pre-population. Scoped per LSP account — drivers are NOT globally visible across accounts.

key_fields.name: driver_name
key_fields.description: Driver full name.

key_fields.name: driver_license
key_fields.description: Driver license number. Paired with name.

key_fields.name: truck_rego
key_fields.description: Default vehicle registration.

key_fields.name: site_induction
key_fields.description: Whether driver has completed site induction. If true, site induction acceptance is skipped during booking.

lifecycle.warn: Static entity — created during booking flow, no state transitions.

entities.name: Delivery Order (DO)
entities.description: Document required per HBL for pickup authorization. Uploaded by LSP or P4TC, validated by ACFS. Each tier in the HBL hierarchy uploads independently — no inheritance. Free release removes the DO requirement for that tier. Under-bond HBLs skip DO requirement entirely.

key_fields.name: do_id
key_fields.description: System-generated unique ID.

key_fields.name: hbl_id
key_fields.description: HBL this DO belongs to.

key_fields.name: uploaded_by
key_fields.description: LSP or P4TC who uploaded the document.

key_fields.name: upload_date
key_fields.description: When the DO was uploaded.

key_fields.name: document_url
key_fields.description: Stored document reference/URL.

key_fields.name: tier_level
key_fields.description: Which level in the HBL hierarchy this DO covers. Each tier uploads independently.

transitions.trigger: LSP or P4TC uploads DO document
HBL has free_release flag or under_bond flag
ACFS confirms DO matches HBL details
ACFS flags DO as incorrect — requires correction
LSP or P4TC re-uploads corrected DO

entities.name: Delegation
entities.description: Records the delegation of one or more HBLs from one party to another. Tracks the chain of custody. Can be revoked by ACFS.

key_fields.name: delegation_id
key_fields.description: System-generated unique ID.

key_fields.name: delegator
key_fields.description: LSP or P4TC who initiated the delegation.

key_fields.name: delegatee
key_fields.description: Target party — existing LSP (by ID) or new P4TC (by email).

key_fields.name: delegation_method
key_fields.description: Whether delegating to a registered LSP or creating a one-off P4TC.

key_fields.name: hbl_ids
key_fields.description: HBLs included in this delegation.

key_fields.name: created_at
key_fields.description: When the delegation was created.

entities.name: Maximus Integration (Inbound)
entities.description: Primary data source for HBL shipment data. Periodic batch sync from custom cargo table. Portal fetches data starting 7 days before vessel arrival. Provides lowest-level HBL references, weight, volume, customs clearance status, and consignee data. Does NOT provide HBL hierarchy relationships or freight forwarder party assignments.

key_fields.name: direction
key_fields.description: Inbound — Maximus → Portal

key_fields.name: frequency
key_fields.description: Batch: once or twice daily. Auto-synced on LSP login.

key_fields.name: data_provided
key_fields.description: Lowest-level HBL number, weight, volume, customs clearance status (from ICS — update frequency unclear), consignee, quantity, pack type, description, marks and numbers.

key_fields.name: data_not_provided
key_fields.description: HBL hierarchy relationships (parent-child), freight forwarder party assignments, alternative HBL references.

key_fields.name: status
key_fields.description: Known — data structure understood. ICS customs update frequency is unclear (OQ-038).

entities.name: AGS Data Feed (Inbound)
entities.description: Provides master HBL references, HBL hierarchy (parent-child relationships), and freight forwarder party data (name, account code). Data is consistent (unlike ICS which has variations across organisations). Matt and William are defining the exact data format and delivery mechanism.

key_fields.name: direction
key_fields.description: Inbound — AGS → Portal

key_fields.name: frequency
key_fields.description: TBD — Matt and William resolving (OQ-034).

key_fields.name: data_provided
key_fields.description: Master HBL references (500-prefix), HBL hierarchy (parent-child), freight forwarder party assignments (account name, account code), consignee at each level.

key_fields.name: data_not_provided
key_fields.description: Lowest-level HBL details (comes from Maximus instead).

key_fields.name: status
key_fields.description: BLOCKER — exact data format, delivery mechanism, and frequency TBD. This is the single biggest technical risk.
key_fields.warn: Cannot build auto-assignment or HBL hierarchy without this feed. Matt and William working on it.

entities.name: Payment Integration (Outbound)
entities.description: Payment processing for booking fees. Redirects user to external payment interface. Provider decision pending (OQ-035).

key_fields.name: direction
key_fields.description: Outbound — Portal → Stripe or Compay

key_fields.name: frequency
key_fields.description: Real-time — triggered on each booking.

key_fields.name: provider
key_fields.description: Stripe (team experience) or Compay (customer familiarity). Open decision (OQ-035).

entities.name: Email Notifications (Outbound)
entities.description: Event-driven email notifications sent by the portal.

key_fields.name: direction
key_fields.description: Outbound — Portal → Email

key_fields.name: triggers
key_fields.description: Delegation (secure link + OTP), booking confirmation (to account email), booking update (to booking party), booking cancellation (to booking party), user creation (welcome email with signin link).

key_fields.name: not_sent_to
key_fields.description: Driver — no system emails. Booking party forwards details externally.

entities.name: LSP Registry Seed (One-time)
entities.description: One-time bulk upload of LSP party data from AGS portal/party manager into the portal local DB.

key_fields.name: direction
key_fields.description: Inbound — AGS → Portal (one-time)

key_fields.name: frequency
key_fields.description: One-time bulk upload at system launch. No ongoing sync.

key_fields.name: data_provided
key_fields.description: Company name, email, company ID, branch code.

lifecycle.warn: Integration spec — one-time seed, no state transitions.

journeys.name: ACFS Assigns HBLs to LSP (Remedial)
preconditions: HBLs have been synced from Maximus
Target LSP user exists in the portal
Auto-assignment has failed or data issue exists

steps.title: View unassigned shipments
steps.detail: System lists FAK shipments that are unassigned or incorrectly assigned. Can filter by assignment status.

steps.title: Select and assign
steps.detail: ACFS selects shipments and assigns them to an LSP. HBL status moves to "assigned". This is a remedial step — primary assignment comes from data integration.

journeys.success_outcome: HBLs are assigned to the target LSP and visible in their shipment list on next login.
journeys.warn: Low priority for Phase 1. Matt indicated this may not be needed if auto-assignment is reliable within the 8-week timeline. Mark as optional.

journeys.name: ACFS Configures Pickup Slots

steps.title: Select site
steps.detail: ACFS selects a site (one at a time — no multi-site simultaneous config).

steps.title: Configure slot template
steps.detail: Select days of week (typically Mon-Fri). Set start and end time per slot. Multiple slots per day allowed, flexible, overlapping OK.

steps.title: Configure cutoff rules
steps.detail: Set booking cutoff (relative day + time, e.g. "previous working day, 4 PM") and change cutoff (same format). Relative to the slot day.

steps.title: Optional: set heat map threshold
steps.detail: Set threshold value for density indicator. System auto-calculates green/orange/red zones. Nice-to-have.
steps.warn: Heat map indicator is nice-to-have — not required for MVP.

steps.title: Block holidays
steps.detail: Overlay holiday calendar to block specific dates.

steps.title: Save
steps.detail: Save/update slot configuration.

journeys.success_outcome: Pickup slots are configured and available for LSP/P4TC booking.

journeys.name: LSP Delegates Shipments
preconditions: LSP has assigned HBLs visible in their list

steps.title: Select shipments
steps.detail: LSP views list of assigned HBLs with shipment status. Selects one or multiple shipments to delegate.

steps.title: Choose delegation target
steps.detail: Either select an existing LSP (search and select from pre-populated registry — company name, email, branch code) or add a new one-off party (email only — creates a P4TC).

steps.title: System sends notification
steps.detail: Email sent to the delegate with a message and secure link. No shipment data in the email body — all details visible after login/OTP.

journeys.success_outcome: Shipments are delegated. Target LSP or P4TC receives email with secure access link. HBL status moves to "delegated".

journeys.name: LSP Books a Pickup
preconditions: Selected HBLs are at milestone "unpacked" or later (BR-001)

steps.title: Select shipments
steps.detail: LSP selects one or multiple HBLs from their assigned list to book for pickup.

steps.title: Validate booking readiness
steps.detail: System checks: (1) HBL milestone is "unpacked" or later, (2) fully customs cleared (including quarantine), (3) all applicable DOs are present. If docs missing, LSP can upload them or request missing docs (aborts booking — offline process).

steps.title: Load calculation + pricing
steps.detail: System calculates fee per HBL: chargeable_weight (max of weight vs volume) × rate. Individual HBL charges summed + minimum charge = total fee.

steps.title: Select slot
steps.detail: LSP selects an available time slot. Density indicator (heat map) shown but does not block booking.

steps.title: Enter truck and driver details
steps.detail: Select existing driver from account-scoped list (search/dropdown) or enter new driver details (name, license, truck rego). New drivers are saved to the account for future reuse. P4TC users always enter fresh details.

steps.title: Accept T&Cs and site induction
steps.detail: Booking party must accept: (1) booking terms and conditions (legal document), (2) driver site induction acknowledgement (document). If driver already has site_induction = true, the second acceptance is skipped.

steps.title: Make payment
steps.detail: Payment via Stripe or Compay (OQ-035). Redirects to payment interface.

steps.title: Confirmation
steps.detail: Booking confirmation with booking reference sent to the account email. No email sent to driver — booking party forwards details externally.

journeys.success_outcome: Booking is confirmed with reference number. HBLs move to hbl_status "booked". Confirmation sent to account email.

journeys.name: LSP Modifies a Booking

steps.title: View booking details
steps.detail: LSP opens an existing booking from their bookings list.

steps.title: Choose modification type
steps.detail: LSP can: (a) change truck/driver details — allowed anytime until collection, (b) change slot date/time — allowed before change cutoff only, (c) add/remove HBLs — allowed before change cutoff only.

steps.title: System checks cutoff
steps.detail: If change cutoff has passed: truck/driver changes proceed, but slot/HBL changes are blocked. Cost-impacting changes after cutoff require ACFS admin override (BR-015).

steps.title: Apply changes
steps.detail: For truck/driver: update in-place. For slot: re-validate availability, recalculate fees if HBLs changed. For HBL removal: treated as partial cancellation with offline refund. For HBL addition: additional fee charged.

steps.title: Confirmation
steps.detail: Updated booking confirmation sent to account email. Booking reference remains the same.

journeys.success_outcome: Booking is updated with new details. Confirmation sent. If fee changed, payment difference handled.

journeys.name: P4TC Books a Pickup
preconditions: P4TC has received email with shipment roster and portal URL
HBLs are at milestone "unpacked" or later

steps.title: Access portal
steps.detail: P4TC clicks link in email to access portal. No login required. Verifies via OTP sent to the same email.
steps.warn: OE security concern: need to verify if email is a Dir-confirmed email (OQ-027).

steps.title: View assigned HBLs
steps.detail: P4TC sees list of assigned HBLs from the delegation.

steps.title: Choose action
steps.detail: P4TC can either delegate shipments further (enter P4TC name + email, optionally upload new DO) or proceed to book pickup.

steps.title: Validate booking readiness
steps.detail: System checks unpacked status, customs clearance, and DO presence. P4TC can upload missing DO or contact ACFS for support.

steps.title: Load calculation + pricing
steps.detail: System calculates fees per HBL (chargeable_weight × rate + minimum charge). P4TC reviews pricing.

steps.title: Select slot
steps.detail: Select available time slot. Density indicator shown but does not block.

steps.title: Enter truck and driver details
steps.detail: Enter driver name, license#, truck rego. No saved driver list for P4TC (one-off users).

steps.title: Accept T&Cs and site induction
steps.detail: Accept booking terms and conditions + driver site induction acknowledgement.

steps.title: Make payment
steps.detail: Payment via Stripe/Compay.

steps.title: Confirmation
steps.detail: Booking confirmation with reference sent to P4TC email. No email to driver.
steps.warn: What existing HBL info is shared with P4TC on confirmation? (OQ-028)

journeys.success_outcome: Booking confirmed. Confirmation sent to P4TC email. HBLs move to "booked".

journeys.name: ACFS Validates Delivery Orders

steps.title: View unvalidated DOs
steps.detail: ACFS views list of HBLs with unvalidated DOs. HBL-centric view — not booking-centric. Can filter/prioritise by slot date/time for upcoming bookings.

steps.title: Review DO against HBL
steps.detail: View lowest-level HBL details alongside the uploaded DO. Slot date/time and booking reference shown for context.

steps.title: Validate or flag
steps.detail: If DO matches HBL details, mark as validated. If DO is incorrect, flag for follow-up with booking party (using booking reference).

journeys.success_outcome: DO is marked as validated for that HBL, or flagged for correction.
journeys.warn: DO validation can be done by offshore team independently from pickup verification. Same people doing pickup verification can also validate DOs, but DO validation is a separate capability.

journeys.name: ACFS Verifies Pickup

steps.title: Search booking
steps.detail: ACFS searches bookings by booking ref# or by truck/driver details.

steps.title: Review details
steps.detail: View booking details + DO validation status + audit tracking history. Includes DO validation if not already done.

steps.title: Validate or reject
steps.detail: If all documents and details validate, change booking status to "processed". If validation fails, booking is flagged — does not proceed to collection.

journeys.success_outcome: Booking status changed to "processed" and ready for gatehouse collection, or flagged for issues.
journeys.warn: Detailed field-level requirements for this view TBD — to be covered in next session with Matt.

journeys.name: LSP Cancels a Booking

steps.title: View bookings
steps.detail: LSP views current and past bookings list.

steps.title: Open booking details
steps.detail: LSP opens the booking they want to cancel.

steps.title: Cancel booking
steps.detail: LSP initiates cancellation. Refund is processed outside the system (C-003).

journeys.success_outcome: Booking is cancelled. HBLs revert to previous hbl_status. Refund handled offline by ACFS.

journeys.name: ACFS Cancels a Booking

steps.title: Search booking
steps.detail: ACFS searches by booking ref, truck rego, or driver name/license.

steps.title: Cancel booking
steps.detail: ACFS initiates cancellation. Must provide cancellation reason.

steps.title: Notification
steps.detail: Cancellation update sent to the booking party via email.

journeys.success_outcome: Booking is cancelled. HBLs revert. Refund processed outside the system. Booking party notified.

journeys.name: P4TC Manages Booking (One-off)

steps.title: Contact ACFS
steps.detail: P4TC contacts ACFS for any booking modifications. No self-service modification for one-off booking parties.

journeys.success_outcome: ACFS handles the modification on behalf of the P4TC.

journeys.name: ACFS Creates a User

steps.title: Select user type
steps.detail: Choose role: Logistics Service Provider, ACFS Admin, or ACFS User.

steps.title: Enter user details
steps.detail: LSP: company name, company ID, branch code, contact name, contact email. Username + password based access. ACFS: company name = ACFS, company code, contact name, contact email. SSO-based access.

steps.title: System sends welcome email
steps.detail: Welcome email with signin link sent to user. Link expires in 72 hours.

steps.title: User activates account
steps.detail: LSP: clicks link and sets password. ACFS: clicks link and SSO login is requested. Successful login completes activation.

journeys.success_outcome: User account is created and active. User can log in.

steps.title: Select user
steps.detail: Search and select the user to update. Available for LSP, ACFS Admin, and ACFS User roles.

steps.title: Update details
steps.detail: LSP: can update everything except username. ACFS: can update everything except SSO details.

journeys.name: ACFS Removes a User

steps.title: Select user
steps.detail: Search and select the user to remove.

steps.title: Archive user
steps.detail: User is archived on removal. Access is disabled and email notification is disabled.

journeys.success_outcome: User is archived. Cannot log in. No further notifications sent.

business_rules.description: Delegation can happen at any milestone — no unpack gate. Booking requires all included HBLs to have milestone "unpacked" or later AND fully customs cleared (including quarantine). This means delegate button is always enabled; book button is gated by milestone + customs clearance.
business_rules.source: BRD s4.2 + PM session 2026-03-17 + Roni/Matt meeting 2026-03-18

business_rules.description: Under-bond HBLs skip the DO requirement. Under-bond is a boolean flag set manually by LSP/ACFS staff in the portal. Not synced from Maximus. Verification happens outside the portal.
business_rules.warn: Full under-bond lifecycle needs deeper clarification (see OQ-025).

business_rules.description: DO rules follow a multi-level hierarchy. Each level uploads its own DO independently — no inheritance or cascading. Bottom-most party must have ALL DOs present across all tiers. Free release removes the DO requirement for that tier.
LSP can either delegate or book directly per HBL — never both on the same HBL. Mutual exclusivity enforced at the HBL level.
Slot cutoffs are relative day + time (e.g. "previous working day, 4 PM" or "same day, 10 AM"). Booking cutoff and change cutoff configured separately per slot template. Per-site configuration.
No-show rebooking is ACFS admin only and free of charge (FOC). Overrides all fees. Reason/justification required for audit trail. LSP must call ACFS — no self-service.
ACFS can partially process bookings — HBLs that have cleared customs proceed while blocked ones are rebooked separately.
LSP can only view shipments allocated to them. Shipment visibility is scoped per LSP — no cross-LSP visibility.
Data is auto-synced on LSP login and on the next call to the integration layer. No manual refresh needed.
Missing doc request aborts the booking process. Booking is blocked (offline) until the DO is received. This is a hard stop, not a warning.

Booking confirmation is sent to the account email (LSP) or P4TC email only. No system email is sent to the driver — the booking party forwards the booking reference to the driver externally via their own rostering process.
P4TC can delegate shipments further to another P4TC by entering name + email. The new P4TC receives an email with shipment roster and secure link. Chain delegation is supported.
ACFS manages user lifecycle: create, update, remove LSP and ACFS internal users. Feature permissions can be configured per user.

Booking modifications by external users: truck/driver can be changed at any time until shipment is collected (no cutoff restriction). Slot date/time and HBL changes (add/remove) allowed before change cutoff only. Cost-impacting changes after cutoff require ACFS admin intervention. ACFS admin can override all cutoffs.

Driver records are scoped per LSP account. Drivers added by one LSP user are visible to all users within that same account, but NOT visible to other accounts. P4TC users do not have saved driver records.

Booking requires acceptance of two separate documents: (1) booking terms and conditions (legal), (2) driver site induction acknowledgement. If the selected driver already has site_induction = true, the induction acceptance is skipped.

DO validation is HBL-centric, not booking-centric. It is a separate capability from pickup verification. Can be performed by an offshore team. Warehouse staff doing pickup verification may also validate DOs inline.

Fee calculation: chargeable_weight (max of weight vs volume) per HBL × rate (single flat value). Sum individual HBL charges + minimum charge = total booking fee. Rate is a single configurable value for Phase 1 — may become per-slot or per-region in future.
Booking update notifications are sent to the booking party's account email when ACFS makes changes to a booking.

Each HBL requires either a DO upload or a free release flag — one or the other per shipment. Free release removes the DO requirement for that tier entirely. This is a per-HBL choice made during the booking readiness step.
business_rules.source: March 18 Miro board — "Either DO or Free release per shipment Free Release Flag"

business_rules.description: Booking cancellation: LSP can cancel their own bookings. ACFS can cancel any booking (requires cancellation reason). Cancellation notification sent to booking party. Refund processed outside the system. HBLs revert to previous status.
business_rules.source: March 18 Miro board — cancel booking flows

business_rules.description: P4TC (one-off booking party) cannot self-service modify bookings. Must contact ACFS for any changes.
business_rules.source: March 18 Miro board — "CONTACT ACFS FOR ANY BOOKING MODIFICATIONS"

business_rules.description: User account removal is soft-delete (archive). Access is disabled and email notifications are disabled. User data is retained.
business_rules.source: March 18 Miro board — "ARCHIVE USER ON REMOVAL"

business_rules.description: Welcome email signin link expires in 72 hours. User must click and set password (LSP) or complete SSO login (ACFS) within this window.
Slots with active bookings cannot be removed. ACFS must cancel or reschedule bookings before removing a slot.
business_rules.source: March 18 Miro board — "ACTIVE BOOKINGS? YES → CANNOT REMOVE SLOT"

constraints.constraint: Pickup slots have NO hard capacity limits. Density indicator only (low/moderate/high based on configurable threshold). Does NOT block booking. Per-site configuration. Nice-to-have for Phase 1.
Slots with existing bookings cannot be modified in Phase 1. Blackout dates enforced via holiday calendar overlay.
Refunds are completely outside the portal. Handled offline by ACFS. Portal is refund-agnostic.
Driver has no portal access. No system emails to driver. Booking party manages driver communication externally.
P4TC (one-off) has no persistent credentials. Services shipments via magic link + OTP only. No account history. No saved driver records.
Site management is DB-seeded for Phase 1 — no admin CRUD UI. Sites have name + branch code only.

open_questions.question: How is Tier-2 FF data sourced? Are they registered in Maximus or only in the portal?
open_questions.reason: Delegation flow depends on knowing which LSPs exist in the system.
open_questions.resolution: Global registry maintained by ACFS. One-time bulk upload from AGS portal/party manager into the portal local DB. No Maximus sync. LSP manually assigns delegate per HBL via delegation.

open_questions.question: What is the exact fee method — flat rate per HBL or percentage of declared value?
open_questions.reason: Fee calculation logic in the booking flow depends on this decision.
open_questions.resolution: Chargeable weight (max of weight vs volume) per HBL × rate (single flat value) + minimum charge. Rate is a single configurable value for Phase 1. Per Roni/Matt meeting 2026-03-18.

open_questions.question: Can an LSP both delegate and book directly on the same HBL?
open_questions.reason: Determines whether the UI allows both actions or enforces mutual exclusivity per HBL.
open_questions.resolution: Either/or per HBL. LSP either delegates or books directly — never both on the same HBL.

open_questions.question: How do delegated parties (P4TC) authenticate?
open_questions.reason: Auth method determines onboarding flow, UI entry points, and session management.
open_questions.resolution: Magic link + OTP for P4TC. Secure link sent to nominated email on delegation. OTP verification. No account creation. Portal access scoped to assigned shipments only.

open_questions.question: Does the one-off customer (P4TC) get a dashboard or booking history?
open_questions.reason: Affects whether P4TC users need persistent state or session-only access.
open_questions.resolution: No dashboard. No account, no history. Link expires when shipment is collected. Repeat users should be onboarded as a proper LSP.

open_questions.question: How fresh is the data from Maximus?
open_questions.reason: Determines whether UI needs real-time indicators or can rely on periodic state.
open_questions.resolution: Periodic batch — once or twice daily. No real-time integration. Portal fetches from custom cargo table starting 7 days before vessel arrival. Data auto-synced on LSP login.

open_questions.question: Can an HBL skip delegation and go straight from unpacked to booked?
open_questions.reason: Affects state machine transitions and whether delegation is a required step.
open_questions.resolution: Always valid. LSP can book directly without delegating. No precondition on delegation.

open_questions.question: How does the portal know an HBL is under-bond?
open_questions.reason: Determines whether under-bond status is synced from Maximus or manually flagged.
open_questions.resolution: Manual flag set by LSP or ACFS staff in the portal. Not synced from Maximus.

open_questions.question: What is the multi-level DO hierarchy — does it cascade or is each level independent?
open_questions.reason: Determines upload UX and validation logic for delivery orders.
open_questions.resolution: Each level uploads independently. No inheritance or cascading. Bottom-most party must have all DOs present. Free release removes the DO requirement for that tier.

open_questions.question: What are the ACFS override rules for missing DOs?
open_questions.reason: Determines role restrictions, audit requirements, and override lifecycle.
open_questions.resolution: Only ACFS Admin role can override. Audit trail with reason is required. Override is one-time per HBL and lives until the HBL is collected.

open_questions.question: Can HBLs from different LSPs be combined in one booking?
open_questions.reason: Affects booking selection UI and potentially the auth model.
open_questions.resolution: Yes. HBLs from different LSPs can be combined into a single booking.

open_questions.question: What payment integration is expected for Phase 1?
open_questions.reason: Determines whether to build a custom payment UI or embed a third-party checkout.
open_questions.resolution: Stripe embedded checkout for Phase 1. Compay is a potential alternative (OQ-035).

open_questions.question: How are refunds handled?
open_questions.reason: Determines whether the portal needs refund state, UI, or processing.
open_questions.resolution: Completely outside the portal. Refund-agnostic. Handled offline by ACFS.

open_questions.question: What are the booking and change cut-off rules?
open_questions.reason: Determines slot configuration UI and booking validation logic.
open_questions.resolution: Cutoffs are relative day + time per slot template (e.g. "previous working day, 4 PM"). Booking cutoff and change cutoff configured separately. Per-site configuration. Updated from absolute to relative per Roni/Matt meeting 2026-03-18.

open_questions.question: What does the ACFS processing workflow look like?
open_questions.reason: Determines the ops dashboard layout, queue structure, and validation sequence.
open_questions.resolution: Search bookings → view details + DO + audit tracking → validate or reject → change status to "processed". Partial processing supported. Data arrives 7 days before vessel via Maximus batch. DO validation is a separate flow from pickup verification.

open_questions.question: What slot configuration options does ACFS need?
open_questions.reason: Determines the admin configuration UI for pickup windows.
open_questions.resolution: Select site → select days of week → set start/end time per slot (flexible, overlapping) → configure booking/change cutoff (relative day + time) → optional heat map threshold → holiday calendar overlay. No truck type distinction for Phase 1.

open_questions.question: What does FOC rebooking look like?
open_questions.reason: Determines whether free rebooking needs a separate flow or is an admin override.
open_questions.resolution: ACFS admin only. Overrides all fees. Reason/justification required for audit trail.

open_questions.question: Single app with role-based routing or separate apps per actor?
open_questions.reason: Determines deployment architecture, routing strategy, and shared component scope.
open_questions.resolution: Single app with role-based routing.

open_questions.question: What is the auth strategy across all actor types?
open_questions.reason: Determines auth implementation, session management, and middleware design.
open_questions.resolution: LSP: username/password (created by ACFS admin). P4TC: magic link + OTP (no account). ACFS Internal: SSO-based access. Gatehouse: SSO via OAuth/Okta. Driver: no portal auth (no system emails).

open_questions.question: What happens when an LSP requests a missing HBL be added?
open_questions.reason: Determines whether a request flow is needed or just search.
open_questions.resolution: No request flow exists. LSP can search by HBL only. Missing HBL requests are not part of the BRD or Phase 1 scope.

open_questions.question: Will the auth model for delegated parties change from magic links to a persistent login?
open_questions.reason: Cross-LSP booking requires parties to see HBLs from multiple delegations. Magic links are scoped to a single delegation.
open_questions.resolution: March 18 flow clarifies: LSPs have persistent login (username/password). Only P4TC (one-off) uses magic link + OTP. This resolves the cross-delegation visibility concern for registered LSPs.

open_questions.question: What are the confirmed milestone statuses from the client?
open_questions.reason: Current list (on_vessel, at_wharf, in_yard, unpacked, collected) is based on PM knowledge. Client confirmation needed before finalising the state machine.

open_questions.question: What is the full list of release types and their DO rules?
open_questions.reason: Only free_release is confirmed. Need the complete list to build release-authority logic and DO validation.

open_questions.question: What is the minimum charge amount and is the rate truly flat across all scenarios?
open_questions.reason: Fee formula is now: (chargeable_weight × rate) per HBL, summed + minimum charge. Rate is confirmed as a single flat value for Phase 1, but minimum charge amount is TBD. Matt mentioned rate may become per-slot or per-region in future.

open_questions.question: What is the exact definition and lifecycle of under-bond shipments?
open_questions.reason: Under-bond is confirmed as a flag (not a lifecycle state) that skips DO requirements. But the full concept — triggers, verification steps, and edge cases — needs deeper clarification for implementation.

open_questions.question: What is the first-time signup flow for a booking party (LSP)?
open_questions.reason: March 18 flow notes "first time sign up flow of booking party — RONI TO FILL IN AND GET CONFIRMATION". This flow is undefined and pending.

open_questions.question: What is the P4TC email security validation process?
open_questions.reason: March 18 flow notes an OE security concern: "is this a Dir confirmed email, if no SW check free for service". Need to define what validation is required before P4TC can access the portal.

open_questions.question: What existing HBL information is shared with P4TC on booking confirmation?
open_questions.reason: March 18 flow notes "Existing HBL? (What info?)" in the P4TC booking confirmation step. Need to define what data is shown.

open_questions.question: Should truck type selection happen before or after delegation for P4TC?
open_questions.reason: March 18 flow notes "need to define if this step should be shown before the delegate to pick up — same to more discussion". Moot for Phase 1 since truck type was removed, but may resurface in later phases.

open_questions.question: What does the driver selection UX look like — dropdown, search, or both?
open_questions.reason: Drivers are confirmed as account-scoped and built up organically. UX pattern (dropdown vs search by name) needs finalisation. "PH" reference from flow diagram is unclear.

open_questions.question: What is the ECST assignment flow?
open_questions.reason: March 18 flow shows "ECST Assignment" as a distinct ACFS admin function but provides no detail on what ECST is or how assignment works.

open_questions.question: What is the auto-WFF assignment logic?
open_questions.reason: March 18 flow shows "Auto WFF Assignment?" as a decision point but does not define the rules or triggers for automatic assignment.

open_questions.question: Is ACFS Internal auth SSO (OAuth/Okta) or portal-native (username/password)?
open_questions.reason: v0.2.0 had SSO, v0.3.0 changed to username/password without clear meeting discussion.
open_questions.resolution: SSO-based access. Confirmed by March 18 Miro board — user management section shows "ACFS USER DETAILS: SSO BASED ACCESS" for ACFS users, while LSP users get "USERNAME + PASSWORD BASED ACCESS".

open_questions.question: What is the exact data source for HBL hierarchy relationships?
open_questions.reason: Maximus has both lowest-level and master HBL references but NOT the parent-child relationship between them. AGS can provide the hierarchy. Matt and William are working on this — need confirmed approach before building the data integration.

open_questions.question: Stripe or Compay for payment integration?
open_questions.reason: Matt raised that most customers are already registered with Compay and suggested moving to Compay. Roni's team has Stripe experience but not Compay. Need business decision on payment provider.

open_questions.question: Is the heat map / density indicator required for Phase 1 MVP?
open_questions.reason: Matt and Roni agreed it's nice-to-have and "not going to stop anything" if removed. Need to confirm priority — could be deferred to Phase 2.

open_questions.question: What are the detailed field requirements for the DO validation and pickup verification views?
open_questions.reason: Meeting ran out of time at this point. Roni and Matt agreed to continue in the next session covering DO validation details, pickup verification flow, and user management.

open_questions.question: How frequently does Maximus update customs clearance status from ICS?
open_questions.reason: Customs clearance (including quarantine) is a booking prerequisite. Matt noted the update frequency from ICS is unclear — affects how stale the data might be at booking time.

open_questions.question: What is the external user booking modification flow?
open_questions.reason: Rules are defined (BR-015) but the UI flow for external users modifying their own bookings was not fully designed in the meeting. Roni noted he would add this to the Miro board.
